text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Bahrain's Emir issues two decrees to increase members of the Shura council to 40 from 30 and give it more say. The Emir promised in June to expand and develop the council to widen popular representation.

- Intoil posts $1.97 million net profit in the first half of 1996. The Bahrain-based company owns and operates oil and gas reserves in more than 12 states in the U.S. with major interests in the Rocky Mountain region, Texas and Oklahoma.
- Fifteen British companies join mission to boost exports to Bahrain. The group will arrive in Bahrain on September 30.
